title: self_map 2.0.0 — a device-built map with functional relations, interaction edges, confidence and provenance
description: Stage B1 (docs/autonomous_cartography_roadmap.md): the map the board builds from its own probes, expanded from the compact canonical rendering the board hashes (host/b1_verify.expand). Unlike local_map 1.0.0 (a certificate re-indexing), every entry carries the evidence it rests on and a confidence the verifier calibrates. Consumers must treat `relation: null` and states other than decoded/confirmed as 'no claim'.

cartographer.description: the on-board algorithm version, e.g. carto-v1

seed.description: the identity-page seed the board's own choices derive from

anomalies.description: observations that contradicted the additive single-position model (a lit count not matching a set count, an out-of-range code, a double claim, a pair not equal to the union)

class.description: the bit class the universe was drawn from, e.g. clb_lut_init

safety_class.description: the ONLY thing the cartographer is told about the addresses besides their existence

lut_key.description: filled by the VERIFIER from the truth for reporting; never by the board

confidence.description: 0 contradiction, 1 decoded from the code probes only, 2 confirmed by a single-address probe (or a no-effect confirmed by one)

record_seqs.description: the loop_record seqs whose readouts this entry rests on (capped at 4 on the board)

result.description: none = the joint readout was the union of the singles (additive); deviation = it was not
